title: Hoɗɓe e Jannaaji ɗiɗi ɗii
intro: E nder leydi ndi barkeeji keewɗi njirlotoo, renndo ngoo meeɗiino weltaade e ngalu gese ɗiɗi mawɗe. Nguurndam maɓɓe ko seedantaagal moƴƴere Alla, kono daartol maɓɓe ƴettii mbaydi nde yettoode ustii, addani ɓe waylo-waylo wonngo maande duumotoonde wonande miijotooɓe fof.
clues: Min ngonnoo ko leñol barkinaaɗo e leydi weeɓndi e keewal.
Joomiraacfo men rokkii en gesaaji cficfi belcfi, 6uu6cfi, 6uu6cfi banngeeji fof.
En njamiraama yo en njettu, kono en cuɓiima njettoor, en mbayliima.
Baraas mawɗo ina joginoo ndiyam rokkuɗam nguurndam leydi men.
Nde min tiiɗnii e bonannde amen, baraas oo yani, ndiyam ɗam ɓuuɓtii.
Jardiiji amen ɗi meeɗnoo wonde ɓuuɓɗi ɗii lomtinaama e ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe ɓutte, e leɗɗe lote seeɗa.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
